programme.title: Allociné
programme.desc: Les émissions cultes, les meilleures bandes annonces de vos films et séries préférés, tout y est !

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: L'histoire de Lizzie Borden, accusée, puis acquittée, pour le double meurtre de son père et de sa belle-mère.

programme.title: Smiley Face Killers
programme.desc: Un joueur de foot se sent poursuivi par quelque chose, quelqu'un.

programme.title: Pixie
programme.desc: Pour venger la mort de sa mère, Pixie planifie un braquage et fuit à travers l'Irlande.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.18
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Vice
programme.desc: VICE est un resort dans lequel les personnes peuvent assouvir leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: Alata
programme.desc: Un drame centré sur l'histoire d'amour entre deux hommes que le conflit du Moyen-Orient oppose: l'étudiant palestinien Nimer et Roy, un avocat israélien.

programme.title: Mon chat, mon chien... et les autres ?
programme.desc: Lors d'un événement surnaturel, le chien et le chat d'Emma sont transformés en deux jeunes hommes parfaits. La jeune femme d'abord surprise, apprend à les connaître différement.

programme.title: Ma belle-sœur bien aimée
programme.desc: À l'occasion des 40 ans d'Audrey, son frère épouse une fille rencontrée en France. Les secrets sont révélés avant le mariage. Audrey et la jeune fiancée française ne s'entendent pas du tout !

programme.title: Let's Dance: Davai, tantsyui!
programme.desc: Nikita, jeune danseur talentueux, s'inscrit au concours « Let's Dance » dans l'espoir de gagner le grand prix et ainsi pouvoir payer l'opération dont son petit frère a besoin.

programme.title: Un Ete Magique
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn, un célèbre romancier dont l'alcoolisme a sapé sa passion pour l'écriture, s'installe au bord du lac pour l'été dans. Sur place, il se lie d'amitié avec la famille voisine, une mère célibataire séduisante et ses filles, Cette famille va l'aider à retrouver l'inspiration.

programme.title: Carla Rubens
programme.desc: Ancienne flic, Carla Rubens est désormais enquêtrice pour le compte d'une compagnie d'assurance. Sans véritable pouvoir officiel, les missions de Carla sont des plus délicates et nécessitent tact et discrétion...

programme.title: A quoi pensent les hommes
programme.desc: Maja, avocate spécialisée dans les divorces, vit seule avec son fils Niklas et a renoncé aux hommes après une déception de trop. Aujourd'hui, sa première affaire dans un nouveau cabinet est une véritable surprise : L'avocat de l'autre partie est Hanno - une ancienne flamme de Maja. Mais en se réveillant après un accident de voiture, elle se rend compte qu'elle peut soudain entendre les pensées de tous les hommes autour d'elle. Cela lui offre de nouvelles opportunités pour sa vie privée ainsi que pour son travail.

programme.title: Entre Deux Ombres
programme.desc: Hantée par un secret qu'elle cherche à fuir, Betty, spécialisée dans l'éducation d'enfants aveugles, arrive en pleine montagne pour s'occuper de Sylvain, un non-voyant de 10 ans dont la mère est morte un an plus tôt. Betty apprend que Franck, le père de Sylvain, n'a toujours pas dit à son fils que sa mère était morte. Elle se rend compte que le père de l'enfant a peut-être d'autres raisons de ne pas dire la vérité à son fils.

programme.title: L'amour au pied du sapin
programme.desc: Ayant perdu sa femme dans un accident dans son restaurant il y a 8 mois, le chef Martin a quitté son restaurant gastronomique. Désormais, il conduit un taxi la nuit tout en essayant d'élever sa fille le jour. Au tribunal pour un prétendu délit de fuite, il se heurte à la juge Annemarie qui finit par lui retirer son permis de conduire.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf
programme.desc: Tommy, un soldat de la Marine a des ennuis et rencontre un agent du FBI.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène. La détective coriace du NYPD Maddy et d'autres obtiennent l'affaire. L'atteindront-ils à temps ?

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Une adaptation de l'histoire de Lizzie Borden, accusée, puis acquittée, pour le double meurtre de son père et de sa belle-mère.

programme.title: La Femme Idéale
programme.desc: Deux amis d'enfance se retrouvent adultes pour s'aider à conquérir les femmes de leurs rêves. Chris veut épouser Allison, une fille juive, tandis qu'Adam est sur le point d'épouser Hannah, une femme avec qui il n'est pas heureux. Lorsque Chris demande de l'aide à Adam pour se faire passer pour juif afin qu'Allison sorte avec lui, les cultures se heurtent et le chaos s'installe !

programme.title: Allumeuses !
programme.desc: Christina, Courtney et Jane sont trois inséparables célibataires, qui ne croient plus au prince charmant. Ces 'drôles de nanas' ont donc une seule occupation : allumer les hommes, ne pas leur céder, mais savoir flairer le bon coup qui les mènera au mariage. Vaste programme !

programme.title: C'est La Fin
programme.desc: Six amis se retrouvent enfermés dans une maison alors qu'une épouvantable catastrophe ravage Los Angeles. Tandis qu'à l'extérieur le monde s'effondre, à l'intérieur, le manque de provisions et l'isolement vont vite rendre la situation intenable. Contraints de s'aventurer dehors, ils vont affronter leur destin et découvrir le véritable sens de l'amitié et de la rédemption.

programme.title: Garde Rapprochee
programme.desc: Sharp, un Texas Ranger habitué des dossiers sensibles, doit protéger les seuls témoins du meurtre de son indic : cinq pom-pom girls, incontrôlables et survoltées ! Il pensait avoir tout vu. Il va vite déchanter.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Jenko et Schmidt quittent le lycée et s'engagent dans la police. A la suite de leur première arrestation ratée, les deux jeunes policiers sont convoqués par leur supérieur. Celui-ci leur annonce qu'ils sont mutés dans une cellule des années 80 récemment réactivée, l'unité «21 Jump Street». Dans une église désaffectée, Jenko et Schmidt rencontrent d'autres jeunes policiers. Tous ont été choisis pour infiltrer les milieux universitaires californiens en tant qu'étudiants. Leur objectif est de démanteler les réseaux de trafiquants de drogue. Ces recrues sont soumises à des règles précises : pas de relations avec les élèves et les enseignants, et pas d'achat d'alcool à leur place. Jenko et Schmidt tente de mener l'enquête, mais n'en font qu'à leur tête...

programme.title: Misfits club
programme.desc: Valeria vient juste de déménager à Madrid après la séparation de ses parents. Nouvelles amitiés, une ville aux multiples opportunités, premier amour… Des expériences fortes qui changera à jamais la vie de Valeria et de son groupe d'amis.

programme.title: La légende de Barney Thomson
programme.desc: Barney Thomson, barbier à Glasgow, mène une vie monotone et sans surprise. Sa mère, omniprésente et tyrannique, veille à ce qu'il reste sous sa emprise. Tout bascule lorsque Barney tue accidentellement son patron. Ses tentatives pour se débarrasser du corps attirent l'attention d'un policier.

programme.title: Ventoux
programme.desc: Quatre amis de longue date partent à l'assaut du Mont Ventoux, comme ils le faisaient il y a trente ans. Une ascension sous un soleil de plomb qui alterne entre sujets graves et bonnes tranches de rigolade…

programme.title: Votre programme reprendra rapidement
programme.desc: Nous nous refaisons une beauté ! Restez à l'écoute pour d'autres divertissements inestimables sélectionnés par Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Hercule à New York
programme.desc: Lassé du Mont Olympe, Hercule décide de visiter la Terre contre l'avis de son père Zeus. Zeus explose de colère et déchaîne un éclair sur Hercule, qui chute dans la mer et est secouru par un bateau en direction de New York.

programme.title: The Birdcage
programme.desc: Armand et Albert ont construit la vie parfaite en s'occupant de leur boîte de nuit à Miami. Mais leur tranquillité pastel est bouleversée lorsque le fils d'Armand annonce qu'il va épouser la fille du sénateur ultra-conservateur Keeley... et qu'ils vont tous dîner ensemble !

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Les 4 Mercenaires d'el Paso
programme.desc: Le voleur Roy King perd sa femme, Alicia, au profit du révolutionnaire Montero. Malgré leur rivalité, ils collaborent pour tenter de voler un million de dollars au gouvernement mexicain.

programme.title: Le justicier de Dieu
programme.desc: Un ancien tireur devenu prêtre cherche à se venger de trois bandits qui se font passer pour des citoyens respectueux de la loi.

programme.title: La vallée de la vengeance
programme.desc: Les fils d'un baron du bétail du Colorado, l'un biologique et l'autre adoptif, s'opposent et se battent pour le contrôle de l'empire bovin de leur père.

programme.title: Mémoires Diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Mass Murderer
programme.desc: Eva est une jeune femme flic chargée des affaires de vols au sein de la ville de Barcelone. Un jour, elle est appelée en urgence pour rejoindre l'unité qui traque une tueuse en série ayant pour cible les vieilles femmes. Alors qu'un vent de panique s'abat sur la ville, la jeune femme pourtant novice dans ce genre d'affaires, va tenter de mettre la main sur la meurtrière… C'est sans ompter la bataille personnelle qu'elle va devoir mener de front contre son inspecteur en chef, qui passe son temps à lui fermer la porte au nez et lui compliquer la tâche au sein de l'unité.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Des années après avoir tué sa mère et son amant, Patrick est toujours interné dans un hôpital psychiatrique dans un état de mort cérébrale. Une jeune infirmière devient fascinée par Patrick lorsqu'elle découvre qu'il a été la victime d'un scientifique cruel et le cobaye de nombreuses expériences. Mais peu à peu, Patrick utilise ses pouvoirs psychiques pour manipuler la vie de la jeune femme.

programme.title: La Main De La Justice
programme.desc: "Quand on confie à Eva l'enquête du meurtre d'une strip-teaseuse, sa vie telle qu'elle la connaît va changer du tout au tout. Magistrat à seulement 35 ans, elle a passé sa vie à étudier et vit entièrement pour son travail, pour lutter contre la corruption. Mais quand un gigolo particulièrement séduisant, Rocco, le petit-ami de la victime, lui propose d'être son témoin principal, sa carrière prend un virage dangereux. Eva, qui garde toujours le contrôle, déportera ses instincts obsessifs sur le jeune homme, qui l'entraînera dans un jeu de possession et manipulation dont elle ne sortira pas indemne."

programme.title: Critical Thniking
programme.desc: Un groupe d'enfants de la classe ouvrière, vivant à l'ouest de Miami, sont regroupés par un entraîneur d'échecs qui perçoit les capacités de stratège de chacun. D'après une histoire vraie.

programme.title: Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942 à Prague, un officier SS est victime d'un attentat organisé par la Résistance. Le 9 juin, les SS encerclent le village de Lidice, soupçonné d'avoir abrité les membres du commando.

programme.title: A l'ombre des regards
programme.desc: Holly est une jeune femme qui se laisse dépérir depuis la mort de sa mère jusqu'à ce qu'elle fasse la connaissance de Shane, un champion de MMA déchu.

programme.title: Stonewall
programme.desc: Des émeutes ont éclaté au bar Stonewall Inn à New York. Cela changera à jamais la lutte pour les droits des homosexuels et donnera naissance par la suite à la première marche des fiertés.

programme.title: Malum
programme.desc: Une jeune policière tente de percer le lien mystérieux entre la mort de son père et l'arrestation d'une secte. Pour ce faire, elle accepte de prendre poste dans le commissariat où son père a trouvé la mort. Bientôt, elle est victime d'événements surnaturels terrifiants...

programme.title: Le Masque du Démon
programme.desc: Au 17ème siècle, la sorcière Asa et son amant Igor, accusés de vampirisme, sont mis au supplice mais promettent une vengeance éternelle à leurs tortionnaires. Deux siècles plus tard, la malédiction se réalise : les vampires reviennent à la vie et recommencent à semer la terreur et la mort...

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: In Search of Darkness

programme.title: Night Shot
programme.desc: Une jeune blogueuse spécialisée dans l'exploration urbaine (urbex) décide d'aller visiter un gigantesque hôpital abandonné. Comme toujours elle part seule et de nuit avec son cameraman, afin de faire vivre en direct ses aventures à ses followers, avec une particularité : ne jamais couper la caméra ! Mais ce soir le lieu qu'elle a choisi va lui faire vivre un véritable cauchemar, les drames du passé y ont laissé leurs traces…

programme.title: Stranded

programme.desc: Wooshi, un Taoïste indiscipliné et coureur de jupons des temps anciens, atterrit au 21ème siècle et sème la pagaille avec ses pouvoirs magiques.

programme.title: BA HORREUR Traques

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: L'ascension et la chute du premier baron de la drogue, Erik Vasquez d'origine américaine au Mexique.

programme.title: Mission Alcatraz 2
programme.desc: Burk et Twitch sont deux taulards incarcérés dans la prison ultraviolente de Craton contrôlée par des gangs rivaux. Lorsqu'une émeute éclate, ils décident de s'allier, et pénètrent dans le territoire hostile du gang sous l'œil des gardiens de prison antipathiques, afin de découvrir qui a déclenché l'émeute. Burk apprend enfin que c'est le chef de gang Cortez, qui a pris deux otages : Cherise, la fiancée de Twitch, et Ellie, la fille de Burk. Twitch et Burk décident de travailler ensemble pour sauver celles qu'ils aiment et faire tomber Cortez.

programme.title: 8 Mm : Huit Millimetres
programme.desc: Tom (Nicolas Cage) est un bon père de famille qui a monté à domicile un modeste bureau de détective. Sa mission actuelle est de rechercher l'origine d'un petit film de 8 mm contenant des images violentes et atroces. Cela l'entraine alors dans les recoins les plus sombres de la société et il s'éloigne petit à petit de sa famille. Il comprend à quel point un film de 8 mm peut être fatal... © 1998 COLUMBIA PICTURES INDUSTRIES, INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.

programme.title: Sheena Reine De La Jungle

Un journaliste télé à l'esprit caustique, Vic Casey, lui donne une leçon en amour personnelle. En Afrique pour un reportage sur un joueur de football de sang royal, le Prince Otwani, Vic se trouve rapidement mêlé à un nid d'intrigues politiques.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: The Green Heart of Croatia
programme.sub-title: At the Banks of River Sava
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: Inside Pass
programme.desc: Versatile Playmaker Stephen Perofeta gives his take on a 2017 match where his side, Taranaki, were challening for the Ranfurly Shield against Canterbury. Young Centre Alex Nankivell reveals one of his favourite moments from the 2019 NPC final, the first championship that Tasman Mako has won. Introduced as "The Golden Boy", nobody could have expected Jeff Wilson's amazing Test debut in Scotland. It would only be a prelude to an exhilarating career full of many memorable moments. The third All Black to reach 100 Tests, Keven Mealamu reminisces on his 16-year career, which took him from Eden Park all the way to his homeland of Samoa. A standout since his junior years, Victor Vito would become one of a select few dual Rugby World Cup winning players. The Blindside Flanker reveals some of his favourite moments including the Hurricanes 2016 Super Rugby triumph. All Blacks Captain Sam Cane is a stalwart of current New Zealand Rugby. The loose forward takes a look back at some of the greatest moments and wins of his career.

programme.title: Inside Pass
programme.desc: 2013 World Player of the Year and double World Cup winner, Kieran Reed reveals his greatest rugby moments in what was unquestionably an epic career as an All Black Captain. From the most conversions by an All Black on his Test debut to a premier fly-half in France, Luke McAlister looks back at the greatest moments of his career including his kicking duel against Jonny Wilkinson. Known for his accurate kicking ability, dazzling playmaking, and dynamic play style, First Five-Eighth Richie Mo'unga reveals his top six moments from his All Black and Crusaders career. All Blacks Captain Sam Cane is a stalwart of current New Zealand Rugby. The loose forward takes a look back at some of the greatest moments and wins of his career. Half Back Brad Weber has had his fair share of spectacular moments in his career. Nothing, however, tops his involvement in the 2019 World Rugby Try Of The Year.

programme.title: Inside Pass
programme.desc: One of the greatest sevens players in New Zealand Rugby history, the 2008 IRB Sevens Player Of The Year and 2010 Commonwealth Gold Medalist DJ Forbes recaps some of the greatest moments of his career. A pioneer of the women's game, Anna Richards enjoyed a 20 year career which included four World Cup wins. The World Rugby Hall Of Famer takes a look back at some of her most memorable moments. The Barrett brothers have shared some exciting moments together throughout their collective years. The youngest, Jordie, gives his take on a try that included not only him but his two older brothers, Beauden and Scott. One of the youngest and brightest prospects in New Zealand Rugby, Folau Fakatava gives his take on a Super Rugby try that symbolized a passing of the torch moment between himself and Aaron Smith. Powerful loose forward Pita Gus Sowakukla gives his take on his favourites try from the 2023 Super Rugby season that involved some flair and poise. Known for his lanky frame and lineout ability, Ian Jones dominated the 90's in tandem with Robin Brooke in the Lock position. "Kamo" takes a look back at the greatest moments of his career including his impressive debut in Scotland.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: The Answer Smurf
programme.desc: Nobody ever listens to Brainy Smurf's advice, and when Papa Smurf is away and Brainy feels he's in charge, he decides he's going to be the one with all the answers. There is a magic formula in Papa Smurf's Book of Spells that ensures everyone in the Village of the Smurfs is going to ask for Brain's opinion. As if matters weren't difficult enough, here's Gargamel...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Tallest Smurf: Smurfs are three apples high. Smurflings are twenty-five smurfberries high. Except for Slouchy, who only measures twenty-two smurfberries. Apart from Baby Smurf, Slouchy is the shortest Smurf, and the jibes and taunts of the other Smurflings make him wish he were the tallest of the Smurfs... Now it so happens that Gourdy the Genie loves to grant wishes...

programme.title: Smurfette's Gift
programme.desc: Every year, Smurfette snoops around to discover what her birthday presents will be before she receives them. But this year, Sassette has created the Keep-Smurfette's-Presents-a-Surprise-Committee. Nat has discovered a cave where they might be able to hide all the gifts prepared by the Smurfs. But what this cave also hides is a greedy imp who is not only interested in keeping Smurfette's gifts...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Sassette's Tooth: Oh dear! Sassette has lost a tooth. Papa Smurf explains that if she puts her tooth under her pillow, the Mouse Fairy will bring her a present in the morning. But the next morning there is no present under the pillow. The Mouse Fairy has not been. She has been captured in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. And now the evil wizard is concocting a dreadful plan.

programme.title: Smurfs On Wheels
programme.desc: Every year, all the Smurfs make the long hike to Dreamy Steamy Springs. But this year, only Grandpa Smurf, Papa Smurf and Nat are going to walk there. All the other Smurfs are too busy – and too lazy – to walk. But then Handy comes up with what he calls his Customised Smurfwagon. No need to walk, you just let yourself roll along... Of course, things won't be as simple as all that.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Calling Dr Smurf: As his name implies, Dabbler Smurf is incapable of staying put in any one activity. He goes from one pursuit to another with the greatest of ease and never finishes what he's begun. But suddenly here he is smitten by the love of the medical profession. Dabbler wants to become a doctor and all of the Smurfs, with Papa Smurf in the lead, are going to help him to achieve his wish.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - All The Smurf's A Stage: Poet Smurf's new play is going to be his greatest work ever, and it will feature the most favourite Smurf of all: Smurfette in the leading female role. All the other Smurfs vie for the honour of playing opposite Smurfette. Even Timid Smurf, who is the shy and retiring type, is a candidate for the part. Brainy Smurf, self-appointed manager of the play, does not see it that way...

programme.title: Reckless Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel's plan cannot fail. Undeterred by Azrael's derisive cackling, the evil wizard perfects a magic substance called Daredevil Dust, which is going to change all the Smurfs into rash, incautious swashbucklers. Will Papa Smurf fall into Gargamel's trap? Will their enemy catch all the Smurfs? Will this story have a happy ending?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Popular Smurf: Jokey's surprise exploding packages have been changed by a spell. Picture the practical joker's discombobulating when he realises that all the surprises that he hands to unsuspecting Smurfs contain nothing but real gifts! No more ka-boom, no more jokes, no more fun! Plus the unenviable new position of Most Popular Smurf in the Village, surrounded by admirers begging for more presents...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - I Smurf To The Trees: Helped, if that is the right word, by Scruple, his apprentice, the evil wizard Gargamel once again wants to catch the Smurfs. He is able to steal from Mother Nature a magic formula that wakes up the trees. Suddenly the forest speaks and moves! Now, for sure, Gargamel will be able to capture the little blue people, won't he? Or will he? And what if all the trees leave for good?

programme.title: A Myna Problem
programme.desc: Clumsy has found a new friend. Scruple lures his master into drinking it... and paradoxically, this means that the Smurf Village is in greater danger than ever!

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Bare Knuckle
programme.desc: EXPERIENCE THE ULTIMATE BRITISH COMBAT SPORT, THROUGH THE EYES OF THE BARE KNUCKLE BOXING WORLD ELITE. Despite being centuries old, the sport of bare knuckle fighting is one that's always sat firmly in the shadow of its gloved alternative. Previously shunned to the darkest nooks of the UK, these boxers, rather than for financial reward are there purely for the fight itself, united by a fierce subculture of honour, pride and violence. Although remaining far removed from the glamour of pro-boxing, the underworld fighting scene has recently enjoyed a huge surge of mainstream attention, with many pro-boxers from around the world supporting the renaissance. Attracting huge crowds and selling out national arena bookings, this divisive sport has experienced a meteoric shift in favour, moving from the underground to a prime-time TV sport.Packed with frank, insightful and passionate interviews from an impressive range of fighters, promoters and authors, including Frank Bruno, BK fighter Jimmy Sweeney, and WBC & IBO Champion, Robin Reid, Bare Knuckle explores the legal issues and evolution of the sport, its continual rise in popularity, and the fight to give modern day bare knuckle boxers the professional recognition they deserve.

programme.title: Deadly Target
programme.desc: When Special Operative James Webster (Michael Jai White, The Dark Knight, Blood and Bone) returns home from duty to find his brother brutally murdered, his lethal training immediately kicks in. Fuelled by rage and a burning need to avenge his brother, he sets out to hunt down the perpetrators and nothing is going to stand in his way... As he delves deeper to identify the murderers, he finds himself at the centre of a deadly conspiracy and a secret world of corruption one which cuts deep inside the U.S. Government, reaching the very highest levels of command. With a ruthless military assassin (Steve Austin, The Expendables) hot on his trail, Webster must expose the corrupt high-ranking officials before he becomes another victim to the very plot which killed his brother.

programme.title: A Single Man
programme.desc: An adaptation based on a novel by Christopher Isherwood, A Single Man is a romantic tale of love interrupted, the isolation that is an inherent part of the human condition, and ultimately the importance of the seemingly smaller moments in life. Set in Los Angeles in 1962, at the height of the Cuban missile crisis, A Single Man, tells the story of a British college professor (Colin Firth) who dwells on the past and cannot see his future. We follow him through a single day, where a series of events and encounters, ultimately leads him to decide if there is a meaning to life after the death of his long time partner, Jim (Matthew Goode, Watchmen).

programme.title: Bernie

Reunited with Sophia who previously betrayed her, they embark on the horrifying truth behind their imprisonment. Soon running for their lives, they must save themselves or die.

programme.title: Rock-a-doodle

A contemporary take on the classic fish-out-of-water story as a rooster, who is tricked in to leaving town to seek fame as an Elvis-style Las Vegas singer, teams up with a young boy and a group of barnyard animals on a magical journey to defeat the Grand Duke of Owls.

programme.title: All Dogs go to Heaven

A stunning family film about the canine criminal underworld as we follow furry outcast, Charlie, who comes back to earth from heaven and befriends a young orphan who can speak to animals. programme.title: Humkadam
programme.desc: Humkadam is a first of its kind show on Indian television that presents the complicated dynamics of ‘Saas' and ‘Bahu' in a clutter breaking manner. It tells the story of Tara and Shanti who are two diametrically opposite personalities, stuck in unprecedented situations. Just when they thought life had come to a full stop, is where they had to put their differences aside and start a new journey. Will they become each other's Humkadam to face all the adversities together?

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Fury Spinner Ep 11
programme.desc: After decades of development, Fury Spinner duel has become one of the most popular sports in the world. At this time, the "Ultimate Feast" Invitational Tournament of Fury Spinner began. The protagonist Meteo is invited to the mysterious island together with other top players in the world to embark on a survival adventure. During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. However, this "Ultimate Feast" tournament is just a conspiracy of the organizer Kenji! He wants to use the players to awaken the evil forces in the island to destroy the world! Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.

programme.title: Sanrachna
programme.desc: Shelter - one of mankind's most basic physiological needs. At least that's what it started out as at the beginning of time. From dwelling in caves to carving out temples in mountains, mankind has redefined shelter with every passing era. Though the underlying philosophy of any monument is to serve some sort of function, great architecture is fuelled by imagination. India's architecture is built on that very imagination and is a fascinating fusion of both art and science. From strategically placed astronomy towers to impressive and awe-inspiring tombs, Indian architecture has pushed the limits of engineering and design. Sanrachna explores these architectural wonders and how the makers of these marvels made them without the aid of modern mechanics and machinery. With an immensely astute sense of engineering, the architects were able to construct fortresses that have stood the test of time, unshaken by its changes. Join our host Vaibhavi as she travels through the country discovering the fascinating stories behind India's outstanding monuments and its architecture. Sanrachna will leave you in awe of the past and its ability to do what we can't, even with our modern tools and fancy tricks.

programme.title: Ekaant
programme.desc: India is known for its remarkable architecture and serene landscapes. Its rich history is steeped in mystery its vastness - lends itself to several stories and urban legends. Ekaant takes you through the abandoned roads and alleys of some of India's historic locations. Travelling through the spread out palaces and deserted forts, the show documents and investigates the eerie processes of abandonment of each site. How flourishing towns and cities came to be in ruins, is the question each episode seeks to answer. Ekaant explores the ceasing of life and the triumph of nature even in the most populated of places and takes you on the road no longer travelled.

programme.title: Tyohaar Ki Thaali
programme.desc: Sakshi Tanwar in Tyohaar Ki Thaali decides to celebrate one festival a week and along with the celebration, she also prepares two dishes from her mom's diary which is her prized possession. Along with preparing the dishes she also reminisces into the moments of how she celebrated some festivals and also shares some stories about the Gods.

programme.title: Bharat Ratna The Jewels Of India
programme.desc: Bharat Ratna The Jewels of India is a show that celebrates the recipients of India's highest civilian honour. Through the medium of graphics and information, the show, intends to exhibit hidden unknown and loved stories from lives of these legendary characters.

programme.title: Janani River Of lIfe
programme.desc: Rivers Have Been The Thread Through Which A Nation'S History, Culture And Existence Has Been Woven. Be It Ancient Egypt Along The Nile, Or Indus Valley Civilisation Along The Indus – Rivers Are The Cradle Of Our Civilisation. The Rampant Growth And Development In The Last Couple Of Centuries Has Taken Its Toll On Rivers – Environmentally And Culturally. Janani Is A Journey Along The Glorious Yamuna River, Exploring It'S Mythical And Natural Origins, The Society And Culture That Prospered On Its Banks And The Environmental Degradation It Now Faces. Mother To Cities Like Delhi And Agra, Consort Of Krishna And A Gushing Pristine Stream In The Himalayas, Yamuna Is Not Only A Giver Of Water And Life To Its People, It Is Also A Goddess And A Cultural Icon That Has Been Celebrated In Various Art Forms. Janani Is The Story Of This River From Its Birth At Yamunotri Till Its Confluence With Ganga And The Mythical Saraswati At Allahabad.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.title: Eco India
programme.desc: Eco india challenges natural conflicts with inter-human solutions as they reflect sustaining self and surrounding. From “Changing Flora and Fauna”, Urban Visions being Sustainable”, “Greening Up- creating solutions for greenhouse and global warming” leading us to know how we could “Help Nature, Help Humanity”. As they go head on with “Protecting Seafood and ocean life”, “Addressing industrial Pollution” , land pollution , water pollution , modern solutions to hazardous pollutants, tackling food and water shortage , Recycling batteries, sustainable ways of life , protecting environment with modern and technological development issues and many more to create a better world.

programme.title: Saschiz Old Town, Romania
programme.desc: Saschiz, village, and commune, Mureș județ county is located in central Romania. The villages of Saschiz, Mihai Viteazu, and Cloașterf make up the larger commune of Saschiz. Located in the old region of Transylvania, it lies about 20 km east of Sighișoara"&". First documented in the 14th century, Saschiz is known for its medieval fortress and church constructed by Transylvanian Saxons, a German speaker. They settled in Transylvania when it was part of Hungary. The ruins of the 14th-century fortress sit atop "&"a hill overlooking the village. The late 15th-century fortified church has Gothic details and an imposing clock tower. Along with five other villages with fortified churches, Saschiz was inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage sites in 1999.

programme.title: Lo sciupafemmine
programme.desc: Peppino, italiano in Brasile, lavora nella ditta del cugino Carlo, prossima al fallimento. Ma il tedesco ha in realtà già conosciuto Lucia, dando inizio a una spassosa girandola di equivoci.

programme.title: La moglie dell'amico è sempre più buona
programme.desc: Due mariti sono trascurati dalle rispettive mogli socialmente troppo impegnate. Segretaria di un movimento femminista una, deputata di un partito cattolico e sostenitrice del movimento per il matrimonio perpetuo l'altra. I mariti decidono di accogliere delle ragazze squillo per avere ciò che le mogli negano loro, ma le consorti li scoprono e la moglie dell'uno finisce nelle braccia dell'altro.

programme.title: La compagna di viaggio
programme.desc: Se state cercando un modo per fare soldi, questo non è quello giusto! Una divertente commedia all'italiana con un cast d'eccezione tra cui: Anna Maria Rizzoli, Gastone Moschin, Moana Pozzi e Serena Grandi. Sul treno Roma-Parigi un fantomatico barone aiutato da un'aspirante attrice organizza un furto ai danni dei passeggeri. Il colpo riesce grazie al fascino della ragazza ma qualcosa va storto.

programme.title: Le tardone
programme.desc: Stupendo film con celebri attori, tra cui Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Walter Chiari e Raimondo Vianello. Cinque donne non più giovanissime sono le protagoniste di cinque episodi nel più classico stile della commedia all'italiana: dalla svitata di turno, alla ballerina di flamenco, per concludere con la classica adultera. Cinque divertenti ritratti di donne irresistibili.

programme.title: La donna della domenica
programme.desc: Un Classico del cinema italiano, diretto da Luigi Comencini e interpretato da Marcello Mastroianni e Jean-louis Trintignant. A Torino viene misteriosamente ucciso un architetto. Le indagini portano il commissario Santamaria a indirizzare i suoi sospetti su alcuni esponenti dell'alta società, e in particolare su Anna, moglie di un grosso industriale, e sul suo confidente, un dottore.

programme.title: Amori di mezzo secolo
programme.desc: Capolavoro italiano diretto da grandi registi come Roberto Rossellini e Antonio Pietrangeli, interpretato da celebri attori come Alberto Sordi, Silvana Pampanini, Franco Interlenghi e Leonora Ruffo. A scandire il tempo è la guerra e gli amori che provano a sfidarla. Cinque intrecci sentimentali che percorrono la storia, lungo un arco di trent'anni che copre Prima e Seconda Guerra Mondiale.

programme.title: Amore mio aiutami
programme.desc: Giovanni e Raffaella sono una coppia affiatata da dieci anni. La relazione va però in crisi quando Raffaella s'innamora di Valerio, un piacente quarantenne. Raffaella è quindi invaghita della nuova fiamma ma, confidando nella comprensione del marito che si vanta da sempre del suo essere moderno, aperto e razionale, chiede il suo aiuto.

programme.title: La Voglia Matta
programme.desc: Grande classico del cinema italiano interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi e Catherine Spaak. Antonio, ingegnere quarantenne, durante un viaggio si imbatte in un gruppo di ragazzi diretti al mare. I giovani lo invitano a passare la giornata con loro, tra scherzi e giochi spensierati. Antonio rivive la sua gioventù e si innamora di una sedicenne ma l'incanto non durerà per sempre.

channel.display-name: CG Grandi Film: Bollenti spiriti & Co

programme.title: Strepitosamente... flop
programme.desc: Un gruppo di giovani, ad inizio anni '90, alle prese con l'inserimento nella vita e nel mondo del lavoro, tra sogni, illusioni e divertenti "fregature". Un pretesto per presentare, in chiave di commedia agro-dolce, una garbata panoramica sulla società di allora, con le mode, i tic e le manie dell'epoca. Ma, dopo tanti anni, le cose per le nuove generazioni sono davvero cambiate?

programme.title: La patata bollente -
programme.desc: L`operaio Bernardo Mabelli, detto Ghandi, fervente comunista ed ex pugile, salva Claudio da un pestaggio fascista e lo ospita nel suo appartamento, ignorando che è gay. Quando la verità verrà a galla, Ghandi dovrà fare i conti con le maldicenze dei colleghi e le preoccupazioni della sua fidanzata...

programme.title: I carabbinieri
programme.desc: Un generale dei carabinieri vuole un`indagine approfondita su uno scandalo del metano e dà l`incarico a una squadra appositamente formata. La scelta è avvenuta con il computer, ma i designati sono i più cretini dell`Arma. Riusciranno però, imprevedibilmente, a far luce sul caso.

programme.title: Odio le bionde
programme.desc: Scrittore di romanzi gialli che si vendono bene, Emilio Serrantoni non ne figura come autore: timido e insicuro, ha accettato di pubblicarli con la firma di un altro, Donald Ross, cui vanno la fama e la maggior parte dei soldi. Donald è un accanito giocatore, che perde regolarmente. Dopo una sconfitta particolarmente pesante, Donald ha bisogno urgente del nuovo lavoro di Emilio che si intitola "Odio le bionde", in cui si racconta di un furto ad una villa i cui sistemi di allarme sono identici a quelli dell`editore Brown. Per una serie di equivoci due ladri veri pensano che Emilio sia il loro basista.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: Studio 54
programme.desc: Lo Studio 54 è stato il tempio della disco music anni ‘70, un luogo di eccessi e celebrità. Questo documentario racconta l'ascesa e la caduta del leggendario club e del suo creatore, tra luci sfavillanti, segreti e scandali.

programme.title: Siren
programme.desc: Siren segue le avventure di Eli, un liceale israeliano che cerca di trovare il suo posto nella società durante la settimana commemorativa israeliana per le vittime dell'Olocausto e i soldati caduti.

programme.title: Quello che so di lei
programme.desc: Claire, un'ostetrica di talento, si trova a un punto di svolta nella sua carriera. Quando la misteriosa Béatrice, amante del padre deceduto, riappare dopo trent'anni, le due donne, così diverse, si confrontano e riscoprono segreti del passato che cambieranno le loro vite.

programme.title: L'età giovane
programme.desc: Ahmed ha 13 anni ed è entrato nella spirale dell'integralismo musulmano grazie all'indottrinamento di un imam che, tra le altre cose, gli ripete che la sua insegnante di lingua araba, anch'essa musulmana, è un'apostata. Ahmed che venera un cugino martire dell'Islam, decide allora di procedere autonomamente e di passare all'azione nei suoi confronti.

programme.title: OSSESSIONE PERICOLOSA
programme.desc: Laure vede la sua vita cambiare in poco tempo: sospesa dal lavoro, problemi con la custodia della figlia della sua migliore amica e in pericolo di vita per colpa di un falso pettegolezzo

programme.title: IL MATRIMONIO DELLA MIA MIGLIORE AMICA
programme.desc: Claudia è la fortunata damigella d'onore al matrimonio della sua migliore amica. Proprio lì, però, si accorgerà che ha sempre cercato l'amore nei posti sbagliati…

programme.title: UN AMORE SENZA FRENI
programme.desc: Sophie, si trova in un nuovo ruolo in un'azienda di meditazione e benessere. Il suo partenr d'ufficio, però, è lo strambo Life Coach Jason - il figlio del proprietario. Insieme dovranno sistemare una coppia in crisi

programme.title: Due cuori e un matrimonio
programme.desc: Obbligati a lavorare assieme, una wedding planner e un event planner devono capire come andare d'accordo… finendo per innamorarsi.

programme.title: AMORE AL PRIMO LIKE
programme.desc: Kacey ha un nuovo compito: seguire Ryan, influencer specializzato sul come comportarsi con le app di dating. Il suo esatto opposto. Non è contenta del lavoro ma accetta la scommessa che le viene lanciata: se Ryan le crea il profilo perfetto e le app funzionano, allora lei scriverà nel suo pezzo che la sua attività funziona davvero. Tra uno scontro e l'altro, però, i due capiranno che le app certe volte non servono se la persona che hai davanti è quella con cui riesci a mostrare il tuo vero io…

programme.title: Looking Glass
programme.desc: Una coppia acquista un motel nel deserto, ma presto si rende conto che all'interno si verificano degli eventi strani e misteriosi.

programme.title: Il museo di Margaret
programme.desc: Margaret non avrebbe voluto sposare un minatore, unico lavoro per gli uomini del paese. Margaret sceglie la solitudine, ma un giorno conosce Neil, un artista che fa il lavapiatti. Quando perde il lavoro anche a lui non resta che scendere in miniera.

programme.title: White Flowers
programme.desc: A Roma un uomo si sveglia in una stanza d'albergo: ha una ferita alla testa e una pistola, ma non ricorda nulla della sua identità né del suo passato. Presto si accorge di essere in pericolo, inseguito da qualcuno che vuole ucciderlo.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Quirino cerca di conquistare Gabriella, amante di Alvaro, con la complessità della timidezza.

programme.title: Aftershock
programme.desc: Sulla costa cilena, la vacanza del turista americano Gringo, giunto in visita all'amico dopo aver divorziato, volge al meglio quando incontra un gruppo di tre belle turiste con cui andare a divertirsi. Quando però nel corso della notte un violento terremoto colpisce la zona e devasta ogni cosa compreso il nightclub sotterraneo in cui si stanno divertendo, il terrore prende il sopravvento.

programme.title: Jack in the box
programme.desc: Un'antica scatola contenente un clown a molla viene ritrovata nella campagna inglese e donata a un museo. Quando i dipendenti del museo iniziano a morire uno alla volta, due ragazzi sospettano che il clown non sia un semplice giocattolo.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Bloccate a 47 metri di profondità, due sorelle lottano per sopravvivere mentre l'ossigeno si esaurisce e squali bianchi le circondano. La risalita è l'unica speranza, ma ogni movimento potrebbe attirare i predatori. La paura può uccidere prima ancora degli squali.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Dance-Off
programme.desc: Two cross-town rival dance teams go head to head for the National Nationals Championship.

programme.title: Dance-Off
programme.desc: Two cross-town rival dance teams go head to head for the National Nationals Championship.

programme.title: Il figlio desiderato
programme.desc: A seguito di un incidente successo due anni prima, Amber e Kyle sono pronti a voltare pagina. Ma il loro mondo si capovolge quando Jessica, la conducente dell'altra macchina che nell'incidente ha perso il figlio che portava in grembo, si trasferisce nella casa accanto e ottiene un lavoro con medico di Amber, alla ricerca di una fredda forma di vendetta.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artista trova improvvisamente la sua vita sconvolta quando la sua mostra d'arte viene cancellata e la sua fidanzata modella lo abbandona. Costretto a trasferirsi in un palazzo fatiscente, incontra pazzoidi, una donna di mezza, una prostituta matta e un dongiovanni spagnolo.

programme.title: Il diario dell'amore
programme.desc: Henry e Penny vivono a New Orleans e sono una coppia molto affettuosa, fino a quando la tragedia colpisce.

programme.title: I Met a Girl
programme.desc: Un aspirante musicista intraprende un epico viaggio attraverso il paese per trovare la donna dei suoi sogni, che potrebbe essere tutta nella sua testa

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite, instillando l'amore, la sensibilità e la paura in chi ne viene colpito. In tale contesto, i giovani Nia e Silas vivranno sulla loro pelle i dilemmi generati da una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Dopo luragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012. Il giovane deve ricostruire il ristorante di famiglia, completamente distrutto, ma incontra sulla propria strada un mecenate che crede in lui e l'amore.

programme.title: Tentazioni Irresistibili
programme.desc: Tre uomini devono affrontare la loro dipendenza dal sesso e continuare a vivere una vita normale in una New York dalle mille tentazioni. Con Mark Ruffalo e Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Turbolenze damore
programme.desc: Durante un volo da New York a Parigi, Antoine si ritrova seduto proprio accanto alla propria ex ragazza con la quale ha avuto una brutta rottura tre anni prima. I due rivivono così gli alti e bassi della relazione che hanno avuto.

programme.title: Lanello perfetto
programme.desc: Proprietaria di una gioielleria, Kate disegna anelli di fidanzamento e fedi nuziali. Quando, un giorno, rivede il suo primo amore Jaimie, questi le offre di lavorare come stilista di gioielli in una grande casa di oreficeria.

programme.title: Non è mai troppo tardi
programme.desc: Paul ha una settimana per dimostrare alla moglie, alle due ex mogli e ai tre figli di essere un ottimo padre.

programme.title: Un'estate da ricordare
programme.desc: Zoe e Luke volevano condividere il loro primo bacio ma furono interrotti. Quindici anni dopo si ritrovano.

programme.title: Il segreto di Clarissa
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della madre Clarissa, Stella si reca in Austria per scoprire il segreto delle sue origini.

programme.title: Il miracolo della Carinzia
programme.desc: Quando la piccola Kathi viene ricoverata in ospedale, è clinicamente morta. Il chirurgo Markus la salverà?

programme.title: Renoir
programme.desc: Nel 1915, il pittore Auguste Renoir sta vivendo i suoi ultimi anni in preda al ricordo della moglie morte, agli acciacchi dell'artrite e alla preoccupazione per il figlio Jean, vittima di un ferimento, quando nella sua vita entra Andrée, una ragazza radiosa capace con la sua energia di travolgere tutto ciò che ha intorno e di ispirare nuovamente l'estro creativo di Auguste. Rientrato a casa per la convalescenza, Jean ne rimane incantato e, nonostante l'opposizione del padre, se ne innamora così perdutamente da volerla immortalare nel primo film che ha in mente di dirigere.

programme.title: Broken
programme.desc: L'undicenne inglese Skunk Cunningham è una ragazzina come tante, con un papà un po' distratto, che le vuole bene, un fratello maggiore, Broken, che è il suo idolo, una mamma che è andata via di casa. E un professore che le fa adorare la scuola e la incoraggia a seguire le sue aspirazioni, nonostante viva in un ambiente in cui regnano la brutalità e il degrado. Nella grigia periferia della provincia inglese spadroneggia, infatti, la famiglia Oswald, padre tossico con cinque figlie violente e aggressive, che semina la paura minacciando e derubando chiunque gli capiti a tiro.

programme.title: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: Teddy Gordon, agricoltore, viene chiamato a combattere tra le fila dell'esercito americano durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale. Prima di partire per il fronte convola a nozze con l'amata Ethel Ann e al contempo fa un'insolita richiesta al suo migliore amico Chuck: se dovesse morire sul campo, lui dovrà sposare la sua vedova.

programme.title: SWOP
programme.desc: Dopo aver fatto l'amore insieme per la prima volta durante una selvaggia notte al college, Lainey e Jake si separano. I loro cammini si incrociano nuovamente anni dopo ed entrambi si rendono conto che quella debosciata serata ha avuto effetti drastici sulle rispettive vite sessuali: mentre Jake è divenuto un donnaiolo, Lainey è sempre bloccata con la persona sbagliata. Nonostante si sforzino di tenere a freno il desiderio che hanno l'uno per l'altra, Lainey e Jake realizzano presto che la loro esplosiva intesa potrebbe essere la risposta a tutti i loro problemi se solo potessero smettere di dormire con altra gente.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: Querido Fidel
programme.desc: 1991, Napoli. Emidio è un vecchio socialista che ha trasformato la sua casa in una fortezza del socialismo reale, mantenendo una pluriennale corrispondenza con Fidel Castro. Il destino di Cuba però sembra chiaro a tutti, ma Emidio non si arrende finché un giorno Fidel non risponde più alle sue lettere e il suo mondo si sgretola.

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi. Lola, 25 anni, lavora in una fumetteria ed è appassionata di supereroi e dei film di Michel Gondry, in particolare di “Se mi lasci ti cancello” che non si stanca mai di rivedere. Lola e Jeremy decidono di riprendere ogni momento della loro storia d'amore, per creare una sorta di video diario giornaliero da riguardare da lì a dieci anni. Lola, troppo curiosa, non resiste e si mette a guardarli subito da sola. Video dopo video, ne trova uno che non avrebbe dovuto vedere: Jeremy e i suoi amici stanno parlando proprio di lei, prim'ancora di conoscersi, e del progetto di Jeremy di girare un video diario da mostrare al padre in fin di vita in ospedale. Lola, delusa e ferita lascia Jeremy il cui solo scopo sarà, da quel momento, cercare di riconquistarla. Disperato pensa di mettere insieme un gruppo di strampalati supereroi, che rapiscono personaggi famosi. Il riscatto? Lola. E così le vie della periferia parigina si animano di una scalcagnata banda di eroi da fumetto, impegnati a organizzare impossibili e grotteschi rapimenti. Nel film tre piccoli camei, quello del regista Michel Gondry nella parte di se stesso, il batterista Manu Katché, per anni al fianco di Peter Gabriel e il rapper Youssoupha.

programme.title: On The Count of Three
programme.desc: Val e Kevin, due amici depressi, decidono di trascorrere un'ultima giornata insieme prima di togliersi la vita. Tra conflitti e rivelazioni, il loro piano prende una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Fughe da fermo
programme.desc: Tratto dall'omonimo romanzo dello stesso Edoardo Nesi, il film racconta il disagio esistenziale e la mancanza di ideali di un gruppo di ragazzi che reagisce al vuoto da cui si sente circondato organizzando atti di rivolta. È solo la trasgressione a far sentire 'vivi' Fede e i suoi amici, che compiono gli atti più bizzarri con il solo scopo di dare un senso alla loro esistenza.

programme.title: Music
programme.desc: Zu, una giovane donna con un passato turbolento, diventa improvvisamente la tutrice legale di Music, sua sorellastra affetta da autismo. Inizialmente incapace di connettersi con lei, trova il supporto del vicino di casa Ebo. Con il tempo, la dolcezza di Music e il suo amore incondizionato cambieranno la vita di entrambi.

programme.title: Talladega Nights Ricky Bobby
programme.sub-title: La Storia Di Un Uomo Che Sapeva Contare Fino A Uno
programme.desc: L'uomo più veloce sulle quattro ruote, Ricky Bobby (WILL FERRELL) è uno dei più grandi automobilisti della storia del circuito Nascar. Un grosso e peloso strumento di vittoria, Ricky ha tutto quello che uno spericolato imbecille potrebbe desiderare, una favolosa magione, una bellissima moglie (LESLIE BIBB) e tutto il fast-food che può volere. Ma la magnifica vita di Ricky incontra un imprevisto ostacolo quando viene battuto dall'eccessivo idiota europeo Jean Girard (SACHA BARON COHEN, il televisivo 'Da Ali G Show') e è ridotto ad un relitto dominato dalla paura. Dopo aver perso sua moglie, il suo lavoro ad un suo vecchio compare, Cal Naughton, Jr. (JOHN C. REILLY), Ricky dovrà buttarsi in pista per poter ottenere nuovamente la sua vecchia carriera, battere Girard e reclamare la sua fama e fortuna. Perché come dice sempre Ricky Bobby, SEI NON SEI PRIMO, SEI ULTIMO!

programme.title: Vita Da Strega
programme.desc: Per riaffermarsi, l'attore Jack Wyatt mira al ruolo di Darrin, il protagonista maschile del film basato sulla famosa serie TV degli Anni ‘60, ma gli manca un elemento fondamentale: la Samantha perfetta. Quando Jack incontra Isabel, una strega che tenta disperatamente di vivere una vita normale, si infatua di lei, convinto che debba essere lei la sua protagonista.

programme.title: Cara, insopportabile Tess
programme.desc: Tess Carlisle, ex First Lady, é considerata una specie di monumento nazionale. Come tale lei stessa si atteggia, nascondendo però dietro la facciata ufficiale un carattere bisbetico, ostinato, esigente e autoritario. Ne fanno le spese le persone che la accudiscono, in particolare Doug Chesnic, l´agente dei servizi segreti incaricato della sua sicurezza. Doug, da parte sua, addestrato a compiti ben più avventurosi, già si sente a disagio nella parte di angelo custode.

programme.title: Fools Rush In (1997)
programme.desc: Alex Whitman (Matthew Perry) è professionista di Manhattan, Isabel Fuentes (Salma Hayek) un'americana di origine messicana che crede nella forza del destino. Nessuno dei due pensa ad eventuali conseguenze quando passano una notte insieme, ma il fato ha qualcosa in serbo per loro. Quando si rincontrano tre mesi dopo, Isabel è incinta e decidono di sposarsi.

programme.title: Io tigro tu tigri egli tigra
programme.desc: Film a episodi con Renato Pozzetto, Cochi Ponzoni, Paolo Villaggio ed Enrico Montesano

programme.title: Tre tigri contro tre tigri
programme.desc: Secondo film ad episodi dal cast vincente: Pozzetto, Cochi, Villaggio e Montesano

programme.title: Quando la coppia scoppia
programme.desc: Enrico, caricaturista trentenne, affronta il divorzio, la gelosia e trova una nuova compagna di vita

programme.title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari
programme.desc: Un uomo cerca di bilanciare un matrimonio d'interesse con l'affetto per nonna e cane

programme.title: Tutti a squola
programme.desc: Un professore all'antica finisce in galera per droga e guadagna popolarità tra gli studenti

programme.title: Il paramedico
programme.desc: Mario vince un'auto, ma dopo un furto da parte dei terroristi finisce in carcere.

programme.title: Un amore in prima classe
programme.desc: Un padre viaggia in treno con il figlio , cercando anche di corteggiare una scienziata.

programme.title: I baroni
programme.desc: Leopoldo, impotente prima delle nozze, guarisce grazie a una danese, ma deve sposare Mariantonia per ereditare.

programme.title: Teste di Quoio
programme.desc: Quattro terroristi assaltano l'ambasciata sbagliata a Roma, scatta l'allarme e restano bloccati

programme.title: Cercasi Gesù
programme.desc: Giovanni è un giovane contattato da una casa editrice cattolica per pubblicizzare, con il suo volto, un libro sulla vita di Cristo. Francesca è una misteriosa ragazza che incontra sulla strada e che è ricercata dalla polizia. Partono insieme, ma i loro guai spariranno con loro?

programme.title: Un povero ricco
programme.desc: Ossessionato dalla paura di diventare povero, Eugenio, che è molto ricco, si esercita a vivere senza denaro. Si fa assumere come uomo delle pulizie e va ad abitare in una casa popolare. Qui conosce Marta, una donna oberata da problemi economici, ma seria e onesta. Con lei si rifà una vita, naturalmente da ricco.

programme.title: Questo e quello
programme.desc: Film diviso in due episodi: nel primo, Pozzetto è un fumettista che risolve la sua crisi creativa grazie a una bionda svedese nel secondo, Manfredi fa scoprire la passione a una ragazzina delusa.

programme.title: Burro
programme.desc: Burro è un ragazzo romagnolo che lavora in un piccolo cinema nel suo paese. Il suo lavoro finisce per assorbirlo così tanto che anche le relazioni interpersonali passano attraverso il cinema: Burro, infatti, è terribilmente innamorato di un'attrice, che vede in ogni donna che incontra. Ma forse, alla fine, sarà proprio lei, in persona, ad indicargli la strada da seguire....

programme.title: Chewingum
programme.desc: Chewingum è il nome di un bar, piazzato proprio davanti al Colosseo, nel quale si ritrova un gruppo di diciottenni prossimi all'esame di maturità. Cè la ragazza con gli amanti che arrivano in Maserati, c'é la coppia fissa, il playboy, la bruttina, c'é quello che cita Buñuel per conquistare la supplente di filosofia. Tra scene di gelosia e goliardate si arriva finalmente al giorno dell'esame.

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. Quando scopre il tradimento della moglie, Bill non ha più nulla da perdere e si rivolge al ragazzo come modello di ispirazione per cambiare la propria esistenza.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Quando Joel (Paul Rudd) e Molly (Amy Poehler) si incontrano, è odio a prima vista: la grande azienda produttrice di dolciumi di lui minaccia di far chiudere la piccola impresa indipendente di lei.

programme.title: Swiss Army Man
programme.desc: Hank, un uomo senza speranza perso nella natura selvaggia, scopre un cadavere misterioso, con cui si imbarca in un epico viaggio per tornare a casa. Rendendosi conto che il corpo è la chiave per la sua sopravvivenza, Hank da ex aspirante suicida si costringe a un'operazione surreale...

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno del toro
programme.desc: Valerio è fondamentalmente un bravo ragazzo, si rifugia nei suoi libri, nei suoi silenzi, nel non detto e in quelle poche parole dette a bassa voce. È timido e impacciato, e vive la vita a testa bassa.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Club di belle lettere di Madam Yankelova
